title: feat(lint)!: refuse a form open to anonymous intake that declares a file field, at validate, compile and the publish gate
body:
Fixes #25650

Clause-②: no (narrowing: a form view open to anonymous intake whose sections declare a field of a `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` type is refused at `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Ruling-ref: ruling C on #25572 (the maintainer, 「25619 C 25495 B」, recorded on PR #25619 with the seat record `6383110676`); triage `6385114404`

The protocol half of ruling C: 「访客表单不收附件。供应商先注册账号、登录后再填表上传…发布时响亮拒绝「公开表单声明了文件字段」」. The server half (the submit door refusing a file value) is #25572 / PR #25682 and is not touched here.

## What changes

- **New gating authoring rule** `validatePublicFormFileFields` (`packages/lint/src/validate-public-form-file-fields.ts`, rule id `public-form-file-field`, exported as `PUBLIC_FORM_FILE_FIELD`). For every form a view opens to anonymous intake, it reads the fields its sections declare and refuses any whose type on the bound object is in `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` (`image`, `file`, `avatar`, `video`, `audio`). It names the field, the object and the entry path. The prescription is the ruled route: the visitor registers and signs in, then fills a form that is not public.
- **Which forms are open** comes from the one rule both anonymous doors serve from: `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`). That means `enabled: true`, `allowAnonymous: true` and a `publicLink`. It covers all three form shapes: a view's default `form`, each `formViews` entry, and the flattened `config` of a `viewKind: 'form'` item. Both section entry spellings are read (bare name and `{ field }`), as both doors read them, in `sections` and in the legacy `groups` bucket (`os lint` hands the rule the unparsed stack).
- **The door that sees both halves.** A field's type lives on the object and `sharing` lives on the view, so a view-level `superRefine` cannot judge this. The rule is a stack-level entry in `AUTHORING_RULES` (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`), the registry `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` run. It also runs at the runtime publish gate with `runtimeTypes: ['view']`: a view write's snapshot carries `objects` as resolution context (`buildRuntimeWriteSnapshotSet`, `runtime-gate.ts`). So an active `view` save, or a draft promotion, answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` naming the entry. No door code moves.
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx` (a new "File fields" subsection with the register-and-sign-in route), `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx` (the whitelist cannot hold a file field), `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` (the rule's row in the door table), and the four CLI transcripts whose printed author-time rule count moves from 52 to 53 (`check:docs-transcript-drift`).
- Changeset `.changeset/25650-anonymous-form-file-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, BREAKING, with its ADR-0087 disposition (not-required, no-migration-prescription).

## Lead re-measurements (dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

- **Open-to-anonymous is three switches, not one.** `anonymousFormIntakeSlug` requires `enabled === true`, `allowAnonymous === true` and a non-empty `publicLink`. A form with `allowAnonymous: true` alone is served by no door and is not refused. A pin covers each switch.
- **`anonymousFormIntakeUnavailability` lives in `@objectstack/metadata-core`, not in the spec module.** The spec module holds the candidates half. Not read here: posture is a deployment question, and the publish-time refusal is a metadata question.
- **"A field directly in the form" does not exist.** `FormViewSchema` is strict and has no `fields` key. Both anonymous doors read `form.sections[].fields[]` only (`form-routes.ts`: the GET schema narrowing and the submit `allowedFields`). The pins cover a direct entry in a section, a later section, the legacy `groups` bucket, and both entry spellings.
- **Producers: 0.** None is broken. `examples/app-crm` was measured through the built `@objectstack/lint`: 0 findings, and 1 for a file field planted on its public form. `app-todo` and `app-multi-package` have no public forms. `app-showcase`'s one public form, read in source (`inquiry.view.ts`), uses `name`, `email`, `company`, `message`: text and email. `platform-objects` has no public forms. HotCRM at `a4b3560` has two public forms (`src/sales/views/lead.view.ts:941`, `src/service/views/case.view.ts:527`) whose fields are text, email, url, select, currency, number and markdown. objectui at `a3c0da9` authors no public form; its hits are renderer code and tests.

## Verification (head `f6099df44`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 162 files / 7293 tests passed. This includes the new `validate-public-form-file-fields.test.ts` (13) and the view-rule roster pins updated in `authoring-rule-wiring.test.ts`, `runtime-gate.test.ts` and `runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 263 files / 21489 tests passed. This includes 4 new door pins in `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: the active save is refused with `422 INVALID_METADATA` and nothing is stored; the draft to active promotion is refused; the door and `os build` give the same message and hint; the form without the file field saves. This run was on `e0aa3cb98`, before the docs-only and merge commits.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli test` (unit + integration): 500 files / 6291 tests passed (on `d4c18b25`; later commits are docs and a `main` merge touching only `skills/` and release CI).
- Consumer files that run the registry: objectql (3 files, 29), platform-objects (1, 2), plugin-approvals (2, 24), service-mailbox (1, 4), all passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol run typecheck`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood (the title carries `!`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` passed, 295 files / 2520 tests (3 files and 18 tests skipped). Lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` gave 97 commands. All 97 exit 0, with `--ran` reconciling 97 derived / 97 run / 0 unrun. Two of them, `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, first went red on `plugin-auth`'s `dist/` while the dogfood closure build was rewriting it concurrently, and were re-run green. The first-round red on `check:docs-transcript-drift` was real (rule count 52 to 53) and is fixed in this PR.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on the committed fix): the refusal guard was made always-skip (`|| fieldName !== 'ablation_25650_never'`), lint rebuilt, and the marker proved in `dist/` (4 files). Prediction: 8 of 13 lint pins red and 3 of 4 door pins red. Observed: 8 failed / 5 passed and 3 failed / 1 passed, exactly the predicted tests. Restored blob-identical (`3325e760befb`, `git diff HEAD` empty). On the restore leg, lint was rebuilt, the marker proved absent (`--absent`), and both suites ran green again (13/13, 4/4).

## Acceptance notes

- An `object` write is not judged by this rule: its runtime snapshot carries no views. Changing a field's type to a file type under a published public form is caught by `objectstack validate` / `compile` and by that view's next publish, not by the object's save. `runtimeTypes` is `['view']` only, because declaring `object` would run the rule over nothing.
- The bound object is resolved in the doors' rung order (`anonymousFormObjectName` in `@objectstack/metadata-core`: the form's own binding, then the view's list block, then its default form, then the view). Lint cannot import `metadata-core`, so the rule spells that order over lint's shared `viewObjectName` reader. Moving `anonymousFormObjectName` into `@objectstack/spec/ui`, beside the candidates half, would leave one copy. It is outside this card's declared file surface, so it is noted here and not done.
- A section that names a field `group` instead of listing fields is not read for file fields. Neither anonymous door serves a group's members, so such a field is never on the public form.
